issue.title: [Epic] Expo migration follow-ups & dev tooling
issue.body:
### Summary

Epic tracking Expo-migration follow-ups and dev tooling on the **Expo SDK 56 CNG (Android-only) baseline**: env validation, a real DB migration framework, jest-expo test mocks, onboarding docs, the API client standard, and lint guardrails. Several items are **already partly done on main** and are reframed to "harden/extend":
- **F1 (#109)** env standardization — **done** (`apiBaseUrl.ts`, `env.d.ts`; no `@env`).
- **F3 (#111)** jest-expo is already the preset → add native-module mocks + gate the live `fluent-api.test.ts`.
- **F4 (#112)** EAS/preview docs — **done** (onboarding + preview-build loop documented).
- **F6 (#114)** `no-console`/logger rule already exists → add guardrails for the #82 anti-patterns.

Genuinely net-new: **F2 (#110)** migration framework, **F5 (#113)** API client standard.

### Sub-issues
- [x] #109
- [x] #110
- [x] #111
- [x] #112
- [x] #113
- [x] #114

### Dependency ordering
- **#110 (F2)** is foundational and **blocks** C1 (#99) and D1 (#103) schema migrations — land early.
- **#111 (F3)** mocks support A2/B/C unit tests — land alongside #110.
- **#109 (F1)** — **done**.
- **#113 (F5)** builds on A1 (#88).
- **#112 (F4)** and **#114 (F6)** are smaller; can land independently.

### Links
- Anti-pattern reference only (not merging): [PR #82](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/82)
